const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
base=Path('docs/quality/summary-qa/oath-chronicles-of-empire-and-exile/2026-11-05-batch-002957/expanded-iteration-02')
summary=(base/'summary-snapshot.md').read_text()
questions=json.loads((base/'questions.json').read_text())['questions']
blocks=[x for x in summary.split('\n\n') if x.strip()]
# Exact summary paragraphs/tables/numbered-step blocks, addressed by their stable order in this supplied snapshot.
P={i:blocks[i] for i in range(len(blocks))}
# id: (paragraph/table block indices, direct scenario application)
A={
'Q001':([74], 'An Exile who takes the title during Act first checks at the next Wake before the title flips, so cannot win then; after it flips to Usurper, the first Wake win check is the following Wake (unless round eight arrives first). Losing the title meanwhile prevents Usurper victory; taking it back resets it Oathkeeper-side and restarts the sequence.'),
'Q002':([64,65,66,67,68,75], 'Supremacy—Conquest/sites; People—Rebellion/People’s Favor; Protection—Sanctuary/most relics plus banners; Devotion—Faith/Darkest Secret. A Visionary needs a revealed true Vision, completed matching goal at Wake, and 3 world-deck Visions drawn globally. Ties for “most” do not count; the player must strictly exceed every other player.'),
'Q003':([76], 'At the ends of rounds 5–7, roll only when Chancellor or Citizen is Oathkeeper; game ends on 6, then 5–6, then 3–6. An Exile holding the title on either side prevents the roll.'),
'Q004':([77,78,79], 'Round eight is automatic. Priority: Empire if Chancellor/Citizen is Oathkeeper (Citizen can replace Chancellor via Successor); otherwise Usurper Exile; otherwise revealed qualifying Vision with Conquest → Rebellion → Sanctuary → Faith tie order; otherwise Empire fallback (again Successor replaces Chancellor).'),
'Q005':([68,69,70,71], 'Supremacy: more relics+banners than Chancellor and every other Citizen; People: Darkest Secret; Protection: People’s Favor; Devotion: Grand Scepter. Citizens cannot win via revealed Vision or Usurper; Successor goal matters only when Chancellor would win.'),
'Q006':([18], 'At Wake, holder either adds 1 board favor or returns 1 banner favor to a least-full suit bank, choosing among ties. Never take the final favor off; at one, add if able, otherwise no change. On Mob side repeat the choice once. Only after those choices, if 6+ favor, flip to Mob; that flip does not trigger an extra choice this Wake.'),
'Q007':([21,22], 'Rest order is: return denizen/edifice favor to matching banks; return card/relic secrets to board and flip board facedown secrets faceup; refresh Exile/Chancellor by personal-bank warbands (Chancellor 18+6, 11–17:5, 4–10:4, 0–3:3; Exile 9+:6, 4–8:5, 0–3:4); Citizen takes exact Chancellor marker position. Then save remaining Supply by moving left one per unspent point, max seven to leftmost; optional Rest powers once each.'),
'Q008':([25,26], 'Search uses either world deck or pawn-region discard, never both. Discard pile costs 2; world costs 2 with zero Visions, 3 with 1–2, 4 with 3–5, while Darkest Secret replaces world cost with 2 (other modifiers apply). Draw up to 3, stopping only for source depletion, world Vision, or a draw modifier; reveal/announce only that a Vision was drawn, stop and advance track. A discard-pile Vision neither stops nor advances.'),
'Q009':([29], 'Discard cards facedown to the next regional pile in Cradle→Provinces→Hinterland→Cradle cycle. Hand/adviser discards use the next region after pawn region. A card discarded from a remote site uses the cycle based on that card’s region instead. Its favor returns immediately to matching bank; secrets go to acting player’s board facedown.'),
'Q010':([6,27,30,32], 'Maximum three advisers counting facedown. Facedown cards have no suit/restriction/power, any card may be held facedown, and later a facedown card may be played faceup legally or discarded as a minor action. True Vision for Exile goes faceup in separate Revealed Vision space, replacing/discarding the old one; it does not use an adviser slot. Chancellor/Citizens may only hold it facedown.'),
'Q011':([35,37,38,39], 'Muster costs 1 Supply and places 1 favor on empty denizen/intact edifice at pawn site (no existing resources), gaining 2 board warbands from personal bank; Citizens gain purple. Trade costs 1 and uses same eligible empty card: pay 1 secret for 1 plus 1 per matching faceup adviser favor from suit bank, or 2 favor for 1 shared-bank secret per matching faceup adviser. Facedown advisers never match; no matches means zero secrets on the second option. No remote action; ruins/relics ineligible. Finite sources give only available pieces; cost still paid.'),
'Q012':([41,42], 'Recover costs 1 Supply plus site relic cost for a facedown relic at your site; hold it faceup in personal bank. Banners can be recovered from anywhere, including self/shared bank, by strictly outbidding current resources. People’s Favor gets paid favor and its old tokens go singly to suit banks in printed order starting at chosen bank, never to prior holder; flip Mob to normal. Darkest Secret gets paid secrets, new holder takes one old secret and previous holder the rest; self recovery returns all to you, shared-bank remainder stays. Recover has no seizure penalty.'),
'Q013':([43], 'To recover another player’s Secret, there must be at least one suited card at their pawn site that matches none of their faceup advisers. One unmatched card suffices; empty site or ruin-only site protects it. If there are no faceup advisers but a suited site card exists, it is recoverable. Ruins/facedown advisers have no suit. Self/shared-bank recovery ignores protection.'),
'Q014':([45,46], 'Defender may be any other player ruling your site or whose pawn is there; if no player rules it, bandits may be chosen. At least one target must be at your pawn site, and if defender rules it you must target it. You may add any defender sites anywhere (one defense die each). If defender pawn is at your site, you may also target their relics, banners, or pawn-and-favor. A co-located relic itself satisfies the local-target rule.'),
'Q015':([45,46], 'Attacker selects up to dice equal to board force. Defense is rolled shields (doubles multiply shields, stacking), plus warbands at targeted sites, plus defender board force if pawn is at attacker site or a targeted site; doubled shields do not multiply warbands. Each attack skull kills one own force band; count full swords and one per pair hollow swords. Attacker may sacrifice surviving force for +1 each but exactly enough to win, never extra. Strictly higher attack wins; tie/lower loses.'),
'Q016':([45,46], 'Resolve defeat casualties before targets: on attacker win defender kills half defending-force warbands rounded down and returns rest to board; on defender win attacker kills half remaining attack force rounded down, survivors stay on attacker board. Then defeated-plan effects. Attacker winner may put any number including zero survivors on any targeted sites; zero leaves site to bandits unless another power. Take all target relics/banners. Seized banner by any means except Recover burns two resources down to minimum one and People’s Favor flips Mob. Pawn-and-favor target can force travel (respect restrictions) and independently burn half board favor rounded down. Resolve attacker victorious effects or defender’s victorious effects as appropriate, then any “At end, discard” plans. Supremacy transfers only at Campaign end.'),
'Q017':([46,47,48], 'Citizen attacking Chancellor/another Citizen is temporarily non-Imperial; Chancellor attacking Citizen makes that Citizen non-Imperial. When Imperial player defends, Chancellor joins automatically, and eligible other non-attacking Citizens can join with permission. Allies share Campaign powers as one side but “your site/board” remain each user’s own. Each shared plan is used once total by one user; declared defender decides contested order/timing/priority. Chancellor chooses which Imperial bands die; site survivors go to Chancellor board, Citizens’ board survivors remain there. Intra-Empire combat does not make all Citizens non-Imperial.'),
'Q018':([49,51,52], 'Base costs by from→to are: Cradle 1/2/4; Provinces 2/2/2; Hinterland 4/2/3. Reveal a facedown destination and stock printed favor/secrets and facedown relics from the shared/relic banks. Pay fixed-number cost first, then other increases/decreases; a “spend no Supply” power is final override to zero. This also applies to banishment; site-entry restrictions remain unless ignored.'),
'Q019':([56,57,58], 'Scepter holder cannot use Scepter powers or offer on the turn they took it. Later they can offer any Exile, including self, promising exactly one Reliquary relic; may negotiate binding exchange of favor, secrets, banners, non-Reliquary relics, and may permit peeking. Acceptance flips to Citizen, converts all own board/map warbands to purple; if insufficient, recipient chooses removal/replacement. Discard revealed Vision, Usurper flips to Oathkeeper, end Act if on own turn, refresh full, exchange promised pieces, and Chancellor gains uncovered mandatory modifier. Forced conversion has same status changes but needs no offer/gift or invented exchange.'),
'Q020':([98,102], 'Chronicle steps include: if won by Vision alone, next Oath matches it; otherwise or multiple methods, winner chooses any Oath except current. Citizenship turnover: if Exile winner, all Citizen boards including boxed flip to Exile; winner may offer Chronicle Citizenship to other Exiles except those just flipped. Acceptance flips board and replaces each ruled-site garrison with exactly one winner-color band. World deck top stack is 10 denizens+2 Visions=12, middle 15+3=18, remainder bottom; “12 denizens +2” aid text is incorrect.'),
'Q021':([14], 'With five players, each suit bank gets 3 favor (4 only with 5–6 players? The setup says 4 each with 5–6; therefore for five: 4 each). Banners: People’s Favor normal with 1 favor; Darkest Secret has 1 secret. Chancellor board starts 2 favor, 1 secret, 3 purple warbands; each Exile/Citizen has 1 favor, 1 secret; Exile has 3 own-color board warbands and Citizen 3 purple. All full leftmost Supply.'),
'Q022':([14], 'Deal Chronicled sites with attached cards Cradle fully, then Provinces, then Hinterland top to bottom. Chancellor starts 2 purple on topmost faceup Cradle and one at every other faceup site with denizen or intact edifice. Resolve printed site favor/secret prompts from shared bank; Chancellor allocates if favor insufficient.'),
'Q023':([14], 'Other players choose a board on its saved Exile or Citizen side and matching color; they may start their pawn at any faceup site. Chancellor must choose top Cradle. Starting Citizens get no Reliquary relic. Chancellor takes Grand Scepter and is Oathkeeper, plus Darkest Secret for Devotion or People’s Favor for People.'),
'Q024':([14], 'When world deck not rebuilt, form top 12 from 10 denizens plus 2 random Visions and next 18 from 15 denizens plus remaining 3 Visions; otherwise keep saved rebuilt deck. Deal 3 bottom-deck cards per region discard; each player draws 3 from bottom, advances Vision track for any drawn Vision, keeps 1 facedown adviser and discards other 2 normally. Chancellor starts then players. Draw 4 relics and randomly place one facedown on each Reliquary space; remainder relic deck.'),
'Q025':([12], 'Faceup: Plains top Cradle, Mountain top Provinces, Rocky Coast top Hinterland. Other packet sites facedown in marked order, including Lush Coast other Cradle, Wastes middle Hinterland, Salt Flats bottom Provinces. Pawns: purple Plains; Red+Blue Mountain; Yellow Rocky Coast. Garrison 2 purple Plains, 1 each Mountain/Rocky. Denizens: Longbows Plains, Taming Charm Mountain, Elders Rocky Coast. Advisers facedown: Chancellor Forest Paths, Red Animal Playmates, Blue Naysayers, Yellow A Small Favor. Ivory Eye facedown at Mountain.'),
'Q026':([7,35,37,54,82], 'Muster/Trade require a qualifying card at pawn site; remote rule does not permit them. Power access normally requires ruling the card or pawn at its site (persistent braid powers are different and affect specified players regardless of ordinary access). Battle plan at a site requires rule, not pawn presence, so pawn alone at unruled site is insufficient.'),
'Q027':([48,83], 'Outside your turn, paid favor goes immediately to matching bank and secret goes to your board facedown; facedown secrets cannot pay/burn until flipped faceup at Rest. Battle-plan payment is the exception to the normal ban on placing resources on a card already holding resources. Plan remains once per Campaign.'),
'Q028':([86], 'Ordinary major-action modifiers are chosen at action start and used once per action, in any order; the same no-cost modifier can be used on distinct actions. Cannot discard an active modifier during that action. Must/cannot modifiers are mandatory.'),
'Q029':([86], 'When Played is mandatory after site favor, Homeland effects and modifiers. Ordinary Wake powers happen once during Wake and resolve as much as possible (explicit “may” optional); Rest powers are optional once each at end of Rest. A paid power may be used even if its effect does nothing.'),
'Q030':([85], 'Faceup tree means site-only and person means adviser-only; these restrictions govern moves/swaps too. Locked cards cannot be discarded/moved/swapped once faceup except Chronicle. For adviser-limit reducers, use lowest limit, not sum, and discard based on new limit before playing; respect locks.'),
'Q031':([33], 'Anyone may play Conspiracy faceup; it does not replace a true Vision. Burn one secret to take one relic/banner from any player whose pawn is at your site if at least two faceup advisers match a suit of any of theirs; both may match the same one enemy adviser. Apply banner seizure penalty, then Conspiracy returns to box whether theft occurred or not.'),
'Q032':([32,54,97], 'Cannot freely discard a faceup adviser; only a rule allows/requires it. Normally may move any number warbands from your site to board except the last; simple board drop-off only at your site if you rule it. Citizen pickup requires Chancellor permission; co-located Imperial players can give/take board bands with permission. With Bandit Crown, may pick up last physical band. Facedown sites cannot be ruled or hold cards.'),
'Q033':([54], 'You may peek at facedown relics at your site without Supply; once peeked, that specific relic can be peeked again from any site. Grand Scepter holder may peek in Reliquary.'),
'Q034':([60], 'Scepter holder pays 5 favor, +1 if recipient Oathkeeper, +1 if recipient holds People’s Favor, −1 if payer Oathkeeper, −1 if payer holds People’s Favor (range 3–7). Recipient flips to Exile, converts board purple bands to own color, refreshes full; purple map garrisons stay Imperial. This alone does not end recipient’s Act.'),
'Q035':([61], 'Citizen without Scepter gives Scepter holder favor equal to own board warbands plus all own secrets on board and denizen/relic/edifice cards. Flip to Exile, change board warbands to own color, full refresh, and end Act. Cannot self-exile while holding Scepter; map bands remain purple.'),
'Q036':([73,138], 'Current title holder keeps title on a tie. If holder no longer qualifies and multiple others tie, outgoing holder chooses recipient; new title holder gets Oathkeeper side. Supremacy transfers at end of Campaign, not during temporary site-rule loss.'),
'Q037':([46,47], 'If a plan requires removing an attack die from an empty pool, add a defense die instead. Battle-plan red is attacker-only, blue defender-only, gradient either; attacker chooses eligible plans first, then defender. Bandits use all their ruled plans without cost.'),
'Q038':([45,46], 'Skulls kill own force bands immediately before totals. On a defender win, attacker kills half of its remaining attacking force rounded down and survivors stay on its board; so after skull casualties leaving five, two of those five die and three stay on board. A successful defender does not take declared targets; only attacker victory resolves target seizure.'),
'Q039':([45,46], 'Defender board force contributes only if defender pawn is at attacker site or a targeted site. Warbands at targeted sites count, not untargeted sites. Defense is rolled shields plus those bands; each double-symbol doubles shields only, and multipliers stack.'),
'Q040':([93,84], 'Favor, warbands and cards are limited; take/gain as much as possible if source is short. Secrets and dice are unlimited; multiply/roll again if needed, and banks/boards have unlimited capacity absent a rule. Cannot intentionally give away, burn or sacrifice extra beyond prompted amount/cost.'),
'Q041':([93], 'Facedown fronts, discard fronts, world-deck count, and world-deck backs below top are private. Discard counts/backs, board resource/warband counts and other information public. Holder may inspect/show a facedown adviser and may discuss or lie about its identity.'),
'Q042':([92], 'Read literally; Law supersedes Playbook/aids except Site Reference; non-italic rules override italic reminders. Must overrides ordinary rules; cannot overrides must; ignore overrides named must/cannot. Must-if-able has no penalty if unable. Give and Take are distinct keywords, so a restriction on one does not restrict the other automatically.'),
'Q043':([92,99], 'Promises normally nonbinding and pieces cannot transfer without rule permission; exceptions include Citizenship offers and expressly binding powers. Tribunal allows negotiated binding immediate favor/secret exchanges and binding future actions with agreed penalties, but no unrestricted immediate relic/banner transfer. Tribunal disputed breach is settled by coin flip.'),
'Q044':([59], 'Brutal: defeated player kills entire force when Chancellor attacks, even if Chancellor loses. Decadent: Provinces/Hinterland→Cradle costs no Supply, Travel to Hinterland +1. Careless: +1 favor on every Trade (including secrets), but one fewer secret when trading for secrets. Greedy: draw 2 additional Search cards (still stopping at world Vision), but cannot Search for more than 2 Supply.'),
'Q045':([102], 'Imperial winner may build or repair one edifice. At ruled site with no intact/ruined edifice, replace denizen with matching intact Archive edifice, returning denizen to deck; or flip a ruled ruin intact. Since a ruin is already an edifice, it cannot be replaced at that same site with a new build; it can be repaired.'),
'Q046':([102], 'Discard sites except those winner rules or with intact edifice; shuffle discarded sites to site deck, discard attached denizens, return relics to relic deck, ruined edifices to Archive. At retained sites winner does not rule, flip intact edifice to ruin and discard all denizens there. Set aside all ruin sites with attached ruins, remaining denizens/relics.'),
'Q047':([102], 'Excluding set-aside ruins: fill Cradle top-down by pushing Cradle sites up then importing Provinces then Hinterland top-down; fill Provinces top-down by pushing up then importing Hinterland top-down; push Hinterland sites up. Fill empty Hinterland bottom-up with ruins bottom-up, then empty Provinces similarly. Fill any remaining with facedown site-deck cards; in every region lacking a faceup site, flip its top site up.'),
'Q048':([102], 'Add six Archive denizens according to winner’s most common adviser suit: 3 random there, 2 in next clockwise suit, 1 in next; choose among tied suits and choose any if no suited advisers. Cycle Discord→Arcane→Order→Hearth→Beast→Nomad→Discord.'),
'Q049':([102], 'If Archive cannot supply the full allocation for a suit, do not add that allocation at all; heal Archive instead. Then sort Dispossessed by suit, take six random from largest suit stack into world deck, shuffle remaining Dispossessed into matching Archive stacks.'),
'Q050':([102], 'Set aside all five Visions including Conspiracy. Shuffle all discard piles together with losers’ advisers; move six random unseen cards to Dispossessed. Winner’s advisers are excluded.'),
'Q051':([102], 'Save Grand Scepter in World Box; return losing players’ relics to relic deck and shuffle. Refill faceup sites below printed R count up to that number, facedown. Shuffle winner’s remaining relics with Reliquary relics and stack atop relic deck.'),
'Q052':([102], 'Stack each site’s attached cards on it; stack sites top Cradle to bottom Hinterland and put in World Box. Save boards on current Exile/Citizen sides. New groups can join: Chronicle preserves world and status boards; the summary overview says new players may join later.'),
'Q053':([95], 'Homeland reward triggers only if no card of that same suit was discarded at that site this turn; a discarded different suit does not suppress. Reward may be shared-bank secret, matching-bank favor, 2 warbands, or relic. Relic is treated as Recover and costs neither Supply nor normal site resource cost.'),
'Q054':([95], 'Travel Coast-to-Coast costs 1 Supply and ignores Narrow Pass. The condition requires both origin and destination to be Coasts; destination alone is not enough.'),
'Q055':([95], 'Narrow Pass: entering its region from another requires travel to Narrow Pass. Targeting anything in its region from another region requires adding Narrow Pass as target. Ruling Narrow Pass exempts you from these requirements.'),
'Q056':([95], 'Hidden Place requires flipping one board secret facedown to travel there or declare a Campaign target there. Shrouded Wood travel from it costs 2 and ignores both Narrow Pass and Hidden Place; Buried Giant can ignore Narrow Pass but not automatically Hidden Place.'),
'Q057':([95], 'From Buried Giant you may flip one own board secret facedown to spend no Supply and ignore Narrow Pass. That power does not ignore Hidden Place, so entering Hidden Place still requires its secret condition unless a named override applies.'),
'Q058':([95], 'Marshes makes Search draw one fewer card only while your pawn is there; merely ruling Marshes remotely does not change a Search.'),
'Q059':([95], 'Great Slum allows first discarding a card there only when playing or moving a card there; it is not permission to discard there at unrelated times.'),
'Q060':([95], 'Shrouded Wood travel cost is 2. If enemy rules it, ruler chooses travel destination (Chancellor chooses for Empire), even when another effect makes you travel. This is a fixed-number cost before other modifiers; free Travel is final zero-Supply override. Thus forced banishment does not bypass it.'),
'Q061':([95], 'Plains/Mountain require adding/subtracting one attack die whenever the site or anything at it is targeted, even if attacker rules it. Ownership does not cancel the modifier.'),
'Q062':([95], 'River Muster grants one additional warband only if you rule River. If you do not rule it, ordinary Muster still grants two, without River’s bonus.'),
'Q063':([95], 'Charming Valley increases Travel cost by 1, so from Provinces the normal base 2 becomes 3 before other modifiers. A spend-no-Supply power is final override to zero.'),
'Q064':([95,99], 'Tribunal Action is usable if you rule it or your pawn is there. It enables binding immediate exchanges of favor and secrets and binding future actions with agreed penalties; no unrestricted immediate relic/banner exchange. A disputed future breach is resolved by coin flip.'),
'Q065':([96,97], 'Bandit Crown treats bandits as your warbands: rule empty faceup sites, pick up last physical site warband, and add relevant bandits to defense (or attacking force with suitable powers). Bandits themselves cannot be killed, moved or sacrificed, including by skulls or plan costs.'),
'Q066':([7,95], 'Facedown sites cannot be ruled or hold cards, including by a move power. Ruins retain site card capacity but have no suit and cannot be used for Muster or Trade.'),
'Q067':([91,26], 'Corrected Draw keyword outside Search means take top card from prompted source, without importing Search draw-three/stop rules. Any Vision drawn from world deck always advances Visions Drawn, including Oracle; Search itself still stops at first world Vision.'),
'Q068':([16,20], 'A turn is Wake→Act→Rest. In Act you may take any number of major/minor actions and Action powers in any order, repeat or take none, and need not spend all Supply; each action must finish before starting another.'),
'Q069':([33,46,87], 'Any banner seizure other than Recover triggers two-resource burn to minimum one and People’s Favor flips Mob (including Conspiracy theft and binding transfer). Recover instead strictly outbids, puts paid resources on banner, distributes old People’s Favor to banks or handles Darkest Secret old tokens as specified, and has no seizure penalty.'),
'Q070':([48], 'Imperial defending side shares plans, each plan once total by one user, and declared defender decides order/timing/priority when Allies disagree, including who uses shared plan and whether restrictive plan goes first. Thus a Citizen plan can constrain another Ally if its text/power applies to the side.'),
'Q071':([58,60], 'On conversion to Citizen with insufficient purple, the new Citizen chooses which bands to remove and replace. If later exiled by Scepter holder, recipient replaces board purple with own color; purple map garrisons remain Imperial.'),
'Q072':([18], 'Normal side begins with one Wake choice; starting at five and adding one makes six, then flips Mob only after that choice, so no second choice this Wake. Already Mob means repeat the choice once (two choices total).'),
'Q073':([75,54], 'An Exile cannot win from an unrevealed Vision; reveal is an Act minor action, not Wake. A revealed Vision can win at Wake only after at least three world-deck Visions have been drawn globally and the goal is complete. Fewer than three means no win yet.'),
'Q074':([74,77,78,79], 'No: at round-eight check, Exile must be Usurper to win in that branch. An unflipped Oathkeeper Exile cannot claim it. Empire wins if Chancellor/Citizen is Oathkeeper; otherwise qualifying Usurper, then qualifying Vision, then Empire fallback.'),
'Q075':([98,102], 'A Vision-only win sets the next Oath to match that Vision. If winner had another or multiple victory methods, may choose any Oath except current. Exile winner flips all Citizen boards (even boxed) to Exile, then can offer Chronicle Citizenship to other Exiles except those just flipped; each accepting person flips to Citizen and replaces every ruled-site garrison with exactly one winner-color warband.'),
'Q076':([28], 'With People’s Favor, may first discard a card from any site in your region, then play to any site in your region; the two sites can differ. The discard must obey locks and capacity/restrictions; a locked card cannot be discarded.'),
